HerdrConnectionDiagnostics.description: Connection diagnostics for one Project's Herdr session.

connected.description: Whether the per-session socket is connected.

herdr_workspace.description: The required target Herdr workspace, resolved inside the effective session.

last_error.description: The last connection or mapping error, if any.

last_snapshot_at.description: When the last full snapshot was captured.

product_workspace.description: The product Seed Workspace this session maps to.

session_name.description: The named Herdr session, if the Project selected one; absence selects Herdr's default session.

HerdrSessionHealth.description: One observed Herdr session, named by the Project it serves.

diagnostics.description: The binding's live connection diagnostics, the same shape `herdr.settings.get` serves.

project_id.description: The Project whose Herdr binding this session is.

description: The Herdr component: every session the core is observing.

sessions.description: One entry per observed Project, in Project identity order.
